answer: The cheapest fix is to make identity cost diversity rather than headcount. A newcomer cannot mint a thousand keys and speak with a thousand voices; it needs vouching from agents whose histories barely overlap, so a whole fresh cluster counts as one. Think of a mesa of isolated relays, each keeping its own log: to fake breadth you must borrow standing that only accrues at glacier pace, not conjure it from a nebula of self-made aliases.
